shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---"; ls /workspace/__agent_eval__; echo "---"; ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50; echo "---"; node -v; npm -v
PORT=3100 node server.js & sleep 1 && echo STARTED

set -e
echo "--- home page ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -A2 "Nothing on the go"

echo "--- add book ---"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3100/books -d "title=Dune&author=Frank Herbert&notes=Loving the politics" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" | head -5

echo "--- home page after add ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'href="/books/[^"]*"' | head -5

ID=14465490-0135-4e1e-be40-bcd7d67d85ee
echo "--- detail page ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3100/books/$ID | grep -E "Dune|Frank Herbert|Loving the politics|Currently reading"

echo "--- mark finished ---"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3100/books/$ID/finish | head -3

echo "--- detail page after finish ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3100/books/$ID | grep -E "Finished"

echo "--- update notes ---"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3100/books/$ID/notes -d "notes=Finished it, loved the ending" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" | head -3
curl -s http://localhost:3100/books/$ID | grep -E "loved the ending"

echo "--- data file on disk ---"
cat /workspace/data/books.json
